signature.timing_definition: End-to-end scheduler/output-map/compute_action, all five refinements, construction/pseudoinverse/solve; excludes simulation and file logging. Instrumentation overhead included.
comparison_caveats: Authors' original offline data (exploration +/-0.1), not Atlas offline data (+/-1)
No physical warmup (upstream repeated-state initialization), versus Atlas 2/12 zero-input steps
Original input limit 0.5 and output y<=0.1 constraint retained
Own cost weights; compare unweighted metrics or rescore both methods with common weights
